name: second-brain-transcript
title_zh: 录音转文字先断句分人再按话题切段，才喂给知识库
tagline_zh: 自动字幕没标点、说话人糊成一团、术语听错成谐音，直接丢进笔记库只会污染检索。它先补标点分段、认人、改回技术词。
tagline_en: Auto captions arrive unpunctuated, speakers merged, jargon mangled. This fixes punctuation, paragraphs, speaker.
desc_en: Clean a raw transcript before ingestion: punctuate, paragraph, label speakers, fix mistranscribed technical terms, and split long recordings by topic. Use this skill when the user drops an auto-generated transcript, subtitle file, podcast or lecture transcript, meeting recording text, or asks to process a video or audio source. Do NOT use for text that is already prose, for summarising a transcrip
why_zh: 先清洗再入库，而不是先入库再后悔。切分按话题而非时长，每段自带说话人归属，检索时不会捞到半句错词。
why_en: Cleans before ingesting, not after. Splits by topic rather than timestamp, keeps speaker attribution per chunk, so retrieval.
limit_zh: 只吃原始转写、字幕、播客或会议记录文本；已经是成稿散文的别用，它不负责润色。它也不做摘要、不生成纪要。
limit_en: Only raw transcripts, subtitles, podcast or meeting text. Not for prose already written; no polishing, no summarising, no minutes. Output is.
title_en: Punctuate, label speakers, split by topic before ingesting
